assets.title: Hardening Off — Measured Exposure Progression
assets.purpose: Show progressive protected/shade/direct-sun/wind exposure controlled by observed plant recovery instead of a rigid day-count recipe.
assets.diagnosticUse: Links exposure changes to turgor and injury scoring so users can identify when acclimation is progressing too quickly.

assets.title: Healthy Acclimation vs Light, Wind & Water Stress
assets.purpose: Show realistic healthy acclimation beside early sun/light injury, wind abrasion and dehydration-type responses.
assets.diagnosticUse: Prevents all hardening damage from being labeled sunburn and shows the next evidence to inspect.

assets.title: Transplant Weather Window — Demand vs Root Capacity
assets.purpose: Illustrate how radiation, temperature, wind and root disturbance combine around transplant and why forecast/site conditions matter.
assets.diagnosticUse: Helps distinguish weather-driven transplant demand from handling/root-zone problems.

assets.title: Root Ball, Planting Depth & Water Contact
assets.purpose: Show intact root-ball handling, planting depth, backfill contact and wetting of both original root ball and surrounding soil/media.
assets.diagnosticUse: Shows failure modes such as dry root ball inside wet surrounding soil, air gaps, constriction and excessive disturbance.

assets.title: Transplant Shock Differential
assets.purpose: Compare temporary midday droop, persistent water deficit, root damage, waterlogging and light-acclimation injury after transplant.
assets.diagnosticUse: Teaches users to compare timing, root-zone condition and progression before calling every stalled transplant 'shock'.

assets.title: Establishment Recovery Tracker
assets.purpose: Show a repeatable post-transplant observation series using the same plant angle, turgor score, root-zone moisture and new-growth checkpoint.
assets.diagnosticUse: Helps distinguish a plant that is recovering from one that is accumulating persistent stress.
